lines.cap: The richest knights in Europe all got screwed on the same day. Friday the thirteenth. By a king who owed them money.
lines.say: The richest knights in Europe all got screwed on the same day. Friday the thirteenth. By a king who owed them money.

lines.cap: The Knights Templar. Warrior monks who protected Christian pilgrims travelling to Jerusalem.
lines.say: The Knights Templar. Warrior monks who protected Christian pilgrims travelling to Jerusalem.

lines.cap: They got so rich, they basically invented banking. Leave your gold in Paris, collect it in Jerusalem, with a letter of credit.
lines.say: They got so rich, they basically invented banking. Leave your gold in Paris, collect it in Jerusalem, with a letter of credit.

lines.cap: And the King of France, Philip the Fourth, owed them a fortune.
lines.say: And the King of France, Philip the Fourth, owed them a fortune.

lines.cap: So on Friday, October thirteenth, 1307, his soldiers arrested every Templar in France. At dawn. All at once.
lines.say: So on Friday, October thirteenth, 1307, his soldiers arrested every Templar in France. At dawn. All at once.

lines.cap: They were tortured until they confessed to strange rituals. Spitting on the cross. Worshipping a head named Baphomet.
lines.say: They were tortured until they confessed to strange rituals. Spitting on the cross. Worshipping a head named Baphomet.

lines.cap: In 1314, their last Grand Master was burned alive in Paris. Legend says he cursed the king and the pope from the flames.
lines.say: In 1314, their last Grand Master was burned alive in Paris. Legend says he cursed the king and the pope from the flames.

lines.cap: Both were dead within a year.
lines.say: Both were dead within a year.
